task.title: Install HP LaserJet Driver on Windows 11
task.shortdesc: Follow these steps to install the HP LaserJet driver on a Windows 11 system.

prereq.p: Ensure that your HP LaserJet printer is connected to your computer and powered on.

step.cmd: Download the latest HP LaserJet driver from the HP support website.
step.result: The driver package is saved to your computer.

step.cmd: Navigate to the downloaded driver package and double-click it to begin the installation.
Follow the on-screen instructions in the installation wizard.
When prompted by User Account Control (UAC), click Yes to allow the installation to proceed.
step.result: The installation continues with administrative privileges.

step.cmd: Complete the installation by following the remaining on-screen instructions.
step.result: The HP LaserJet driver is installed on your Windows 11 system.
